## Purpose

Move the info from the Nanaimo coastal correlation meetings into tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class (and write script so that this can easily be done with future updates too)

** Workflow **

1.) Load meeting spreadsheets and current tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class from BECdb.
2.) Run checks on the spreadsheets.
3.) Update the table in R, with spreadsheets from the External_ Coastal BEC Guide - Associations_Alliances_Review folder (BEC.hier_updated), save it.
4.) In Access: 
   - Archive a copy of tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class (e.g., Archived_...).
   - Make a structure-only copy of the table.
   - Append the saved data from R into the empty copy.

## Functions: 

All functions are defined here and used in sections below:

```{r functions}
# --- Find problems with the SiteUnit column of an update table ---------------
# Returns one row per problem (zero rows = no problems).
find_site_unit_issues <- function(update_data, master) {

  su    <- update_data$SiteUnit
  blank <- is.na(su) | trimws(su) == ""
  su    <- su[!blank]

  make <- function(label, units) {
    tibble(Issue = rep(label, length(units)), SiteUnit = as.character(units))
  }

  bind_rows(
    make("Blank SiteUnit",                    rep(NA, sum(blank))),
    make("Duplicated in update table",        unique(su[duplicated(su)])),
    make("Not found in BEC.hier",             setdiff(su, master$SiteUnit)),
    make("Matches multiple rows in BEC.hier", intersect(su, master$SiteUnit[duplicated(master$SiteUnit)]))
  )
}

# --- List cells that are blank in the update but filled in the master ---------
find_blanked_cells <- function(master, update_data, table_name) {

  # Only columns in both (new columns have no "old value")
  update_cols <- intersect(setdiff(names(update_data), "SiteUnit"), names(master))
  idx <- match(update_data$SiteUnit, master$SiteUnit)

  map_dfr(update_cols, function(col) {
    incoming <- as.character(update_data[[col]])
    existing <- as.character(master[[col]][idx])

    blank_in     <- is.na(incoming) | trimws(incoming) == ""
    has_existing <- !is.na(existing) & trimws(existing) != ""
    hit          <- blank_in & has_existing

    tibble(
      Table            = table_name,
      SiteUnit         = update_data$SiteUnit[hit],
      Column           = col,
      Master_value     = existing[hit],
      Update_value     = incoming[hit],
      Column_all_blank = all(blank_in)   # TRUE = whole column empty in the spreadsheet
    )
  })
}

# --- Apply one update table to the master --------------------------------------
# master      = BEC.hier (aka tblBEC_Hierarchy_Chart from VPro)
# update_data = a df with updates to apply to BEC.hier
# table_name  = label of the updated data to be used in error messages
# na_action   = "keep"      blank cells in update_data leave the master value alone
#               "overwrite" blank cells in update_data erase the master value
update_BEC.hier <- function(master, update_data, table_name, na_action = "keep") {

  if (!na_action %in% c("keep", "overwrite")) {
    stop("na_action must be 'keep' or 'overwrite'.")
  }

  # Stop on any SiteUnit problem (the same check used in the checks section)
  issues <- find_site_unit_issues(update_data, master)
  if (nrow(issues) > 0) {
    stop(table_name, ": ", paste(issues$Issue, issues$SiteUnit, sep = " - ", collapse = "; "),
         call. = FALSE)
  }

  # Every column must already exist in the master (new ones are added in section 6)
  update_cols  <- setdiff(names(update_data), "SiteUnit")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(update_cols, names(master))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(table_name, ": columns not in master: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
         call. = FALSE)
  }

  idx <- match(update_data$SiteUnit, master$SiteUnit)   # master row for each update row

  for (col in update_cols) {
    incoming <- update_data[[col]]

    # Empty Excel columns are read as logical; text columns may hold numbers
    if (is.character(master[[col]])) incoming <- as.character(incoming)

    # Strict conversion: vec_cast produces errors rather than silently losing information
    new_values <- vctrs::vec_cast(incoming, master[[col]])

    rows <- if (na_action == "keep") !is.na(new_values) else rep(TRUE, length(new_values))
    master[[col]][idx[rows]] <- new_values[rows]
  }

  message(table_name, ": ", length(idx), " rows, ", length(update_cols), " columns processed.")
  master
}
```


## 4. Checks: 

**Check 1. Duplicated SiteUnits in the master table**

```{r check-master-duplicates}
BEC.hier %>%
  add_count(SiteUnit, name = "Occurrences") %>%
  filter(Occurrences > 1) %>%
  arrange(SiteUnit)
```

**Check 2. SiteUnit problems in each meeting spreadsheet** (blank, duplicated, missing from the master, or matching more than one master row). The update stops on any of these.

```{r check-site-units}
site_unit_issues <- bec.tables %>%
  imap_dfr(~ mutate(find_site_unit_issues(.x, BEC.hier), Table = .y, .before = 1))

site_unit_issues                              
```

**Check 3. SiteUnits that appear in more than one spreadsheet.** If any do, the table that comes later in `meeting_files` wins wherever its cell is not blank.

```{r check-overlaps}
multi_table <- bec.tables %>%
  imap_dfr(~ tibble(Table = .y, SiteUnit = .x$SiteUnit)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SiteUnit)) %>%
  group_by(SiteUnit) %>%
  summarise(n_tables = n_distinct(Table),
            Tables   = paste(sort(unique(Table)), collapse = ", "),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_tables > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_tables), SiteUnit)

multi_table
```

**Check 4. New columns** (in a spreadsheet but not in tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class). These will be added to the table.

```{r check-new-columns}
new_columns <- bec.tables %>%
  imap_dfr(~ tibble(Table = .y, Column = setdiff(names(.x), names(BEC.hier))))

new_columns
```

**Check 5. Cells blank in the spreadsheet but filled in the master.** With `na_action = "keep"` the master value is kept. Each of these is either a deliberate deletion or an accident, so review them. Rows with `Column_all_blank = TRUE` mean the spreadsheet never used that column. The interesting ones are `FALSE`.

```{r check-blanked-cells}
blanked_all <- bec.tables %>%
  imap_dfr(~ find_blanked_cells(BEC.hier, .x, .y))

count(blanked_all, Table, Column_all_blank)

write_xlsx(blanked_all, file.path("DSO_outputs/blank_cells_for_review.xlsx"))
```

## 6. Update BEC.hier

```{r update}
# Start from the original table; BEC.hier itself stays untouched
BEC.hier_updated <- BEC.hier

# Add every new column once, as text
for (col in unique(new_columns$Column)) BEC.hier_updated[[col]] <- NA_character_

# Apply each spreadsheet in turn, logging success or failure
update_log <- tibble(Table = names(bec.tables), Status = "not run", Message = "")

for (i in seq_along(bec.tables)) {
  tbl <- names(bec.tables)[i]

  result <- tryCatch(
    update_BEC.hier(BEC.hier_updated, bec.tables[[tbl]], tbl, na_action = "keep"),
    error = function(e) e
  )

  if (inherits(result, "error")) {
    update_log$Status[i]  <- "FAILED"
    update_log$Message[i] <- conditionMessage(result)
  } else {
    BEC.hier_updated <- result   # keep the new version only if the update succeeded
    update_log$Status[i] <- "OK"
  }
}

update_log
```

## 7. Verify and save

```{r verify-and-save}
# Stop here if any table failed; fix it (section 5) and re-run from section 6
if (any(update_log$Status != "OK")) {
  stop("Some tables failed. See update_log.")
}

# No rows added or lost
stopifnot(nrow(BEC.hier_updated) == nrow(BEC.hier))

# Columns added
setdiff(names(BEC.hier_updated), names(BEC.hier))

# Save for the Access import. SiteUnit was created in R, so it is not exported.
BEC.hier_export <- BEC.hier_updated %>% select(-SiteUnit)

saveRDS(BEC.hier_export, file.path(out_dir, "tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class_updated.rds"))
write_xlsx(BEC.hier_export, file.path("DSO_outputs/tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class_updated.xlsx"))
